name: What Is an Embodiment
title: What Is an Embodiment
description: An embodiment is one concrete way of realizing a function: a lever embodiment vs a gear embodiment of 'multiply force'. Functions are abstract; embodiments are buildable.
how_it_works: State the function in solution-neutral terms ('multiply force 5x'), then list distinct physical principles that could realize it. Neutrality prevents locking onto the first idea.
key_points: Embodiment: one concrete realization of a function.
